M1.reason: The outline reads as the brief's chunky cylinder with a handle on top, upright, in all ten views. Body is about 1.2 times as tall as it is across, and the handle sits on the cap. Nothing sticks out or is missing. Measured 10 x 10 x 18 with the handle, matching the brief's 18 tall and 10 across.

M2.reason: Measured size is 10 across, 10 deep and 18 high, exactly the brief's 10 across and 18 tall. Within 0% of the size the brief gives.

M3.reason: The brief asks for a chunky cell, a handle and a glowing band. All three are there: a cylindrical body, a two-post handle with a crossbar on a base plate (front, left and top views), a cyan glow band around the middle, and a top cap and bottom base. The brief names no claws, teeth, rivets or facet count, so no small part is missing.

M4.reason: The brief asks for dark industrial metal with a glowing element. The body is dark painted metal, the band is bright cyan, and the lower band is yellow and black hazard paint. These read as the brief's materials in every view.

M5.reason: The glowing band, the hazard stripes and faint grime on the body are all in place on the cylinder in every side view, at a clear sharpness. Not required by the brief, and nothing added is wrong.

M6.reason: In the line-up it reads as a plausible Half-Life item in style: low-poly, grimy, with hazard stripes. But the handle is a crude bracket of blocks and the body is a clean generic canister, so a player who knows the game's items would likely see it as a new prop, not one of the game's. Not taken for a game original at a glance.

M7.reason: It stands upright on its flat base at its origin. The handle is on top, and the front, back, left and right views agree on the upright form. The brief's 'lying on the floor' is met as a pickup resting on the floor.

M8.reason: SMAK's check reports no errors. It has 92 triangles, under twice the median of Half-Life's props of its kind (56, so 112) and under the third quartile (116). No open edges, inside-out faces or floating parts show in any view.
